title: Wonderlands×Showtime Chapter1 Episode13 Public Performance!

rows.Line: Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Pegasus
rows.Line: “I must set off with my trusty sword to slay the dastardly demon lord♪”

rows.Speaker: Pegasus
rows.Line:
“Well, if it isn't Ne-Ne the Cyborgian!
Perhaps she would join me on my treacherous journey?”

rows.Speaker: Ne-Ne
rows.Line: “Your Highness, you have restored peace to our village, which had long been troubled by monsters.”

rows.Speaker: Ne-Ne
rows.Line: “I bring you a Hyper Drink, my tribe's famous revitalizing potion, as a token of our gratitude.”

rows.Speaker: Pegasus
rows.Line: “A gift for me, how splendid! Based on its slimy, disgusting appearance, it must be highly effective. I shall drink it at once! Glug, glug, glug...”

rows.Speaker: Pegasus
rows.Line:
“Blah! What is this?!
Oh, how could I have not realized... The Cyborgians only drink oil!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui! Rui! We made the audience laugh!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Indeed. We're off to a good start.
Get ready, Emu. You and the mascots are next.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Everybody, get in position!

rows.Speaker: Pegasus
rows.Line: “Something's there... I sense a dangerous presence!”

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: It's go time!

rows.Speaker: Kids
rows.Line: Wow! It's a big dragon!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's just a repurposed dragon dance costume, but it appears sufficiently lifelike when the actors inside move in tandem.

rows.Speaker: Emumu
rows.Line:
“I'm Emumu, the demon lord's dragon keeper!
My dragon will pancake you, foolish prince!”

rows.Speaker: Pegasus
rows.Line: “Curses! How am I supposed to fight a dragon this enormous?!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's going well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene's solo part is coming up next.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I've been terrified of performing on stage ever since... “that” happened.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But if this goes well, maybe I can overcome that fear...)

rows.Speaker: Pegasus
rows.Line: “Ah, I see! This dragon can be lulled to sleep with a song! I must think of some song to sing...”

rows.Speaker: Ne-Ne
rows.Line: “Your Highness, please allow me to take care of this. I shall sing to the dragon.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I...I can do this!

rows.Speaker: Kids
rows.Line: Ooh, the song's so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Pegasus
rows.Line: “Splendid! The dragon is falling into a deep slumber!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? The mic's not working?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I... I can't move the robot at all! What's happening?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The robot stopped moving?!

rows.Speaker: Pegasus
rows.Line: Wha...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Why? Why won't it move?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
The battery must be flat.
Just how long did Nene stay here rehearsing on her own after I left?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Why did it freeze up all of a sudden?! Is it broken?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (What do we do now? I can't do the scene where I defeat the dragon if she doesn't finish singing to put it to sleep!)

rows.Speaker: Pegasus
rows.Line:
“Ne-Ne, what's the matter?
It seems your song made you fall asleep before the dragon did!”

rows.Speaker: Pegasus
rows.Line: “I need you to sing just a little longer! Perhaps Ne-Ne needs some encouragement from our wonderful audience! Can you please help us?”

rows.Speaker: Pegasus
rows.Line:
(This will buy us some time...
Nene, Rui, you've got to come up with something so that the show can go on!!)

rows.Speaker: Kids
rows.Line: Ne-Ne! You can do it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uh... Um... Wh-What can I do...

rows.Speaker: Pegasus
rows.Line: Ne-Ne, you can do it! Please, Ne-Ne...

rows.Speaker: Emumu
rows.Line: Eek! The loud cheering is confusing my dragon!

rows.Speaker: Pegasus
rows.Line: (Oh! Nice ad lib, Emu! With this set-up, we can proceed to me defeating the dragon without it being put to sleep!)

rows.Speaker: Pegasus
rows.Line: Thank you, dear audience! Now that the dragon is stunned, I shall make short work of it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Pegasus
rows.Line: What the... Argh!

rows.Speaker: Kids
rows.Line: Huh? Ne-Ne has fallen over, crushing the prince!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is disastrous! The autonomous control system has failed!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh no... No, no, no...

rows.Speaker: Emumu
rows.Line: Yiiikes! H-Help! We must save him!

rows.Speaker: Pegasus
rows.Line: N-No... I can still fight!

rows.Speaker: Pegasus
rows.Line: I can't fall in battle...until I defeat the dragon!

rows.Speaker: Pegasus
rows.Line: I can't lose now and disappoint all the children who believe in me!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but I can't let this continue.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Prince Pegasus befriended the dragon and its keeper. His journey was to continue for a long, long time, before he would finally cross swords with the demon lord. The end.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Kid A
rows.Line: What happened next? Is it really over? That's boring!

rows.Speaker: Kid B
rows.Line: The prince had to be rescued by the bad guys? What a wimp!

rows.Speaker: Mom
rows.Line: That was a confusing play...

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line:
It started well, but then it became unwatchable.
Let's go and check out something else.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Gasp*!
